attributes.affiliation_basis: UNKNOWN: the message carries no affiliation field. The BlueForceTracking service's own definition names the members of this list blue forces, which is a statement about the service and not a field of the message, so the adapter asserts no affiliation from it or from the deployment context a message arrives in; nothing is read from a symbol code. A caller that knows the affiliation supplies it: TacticalapiAdapter(affiliation=...) (R3, ruled 2026-10-06)
attributes.course_basis: point_location.course in degrees as stated, read as degrees true: the contract states degrees and no north reference, so the north reference is ASSUMED true, which Kinematics.course_deg means (limitation course-reference-not-stated; R5, ruled 2026-10-06)
attributes.entity_id_basis: identity.int64_identity: the blue force's own identity, keyed as <member>:<value> so two members holding one value stay two identities
attributes.position_basis: point_location.geo_point latitude_coordinate and longitude_coordinate, read as WGS 84 decimal degrees: the contract states the ellipsoid and no angular unit (limitation coordinate-unit-not-stated)
attributes.symbol_basis: no symbol: the element states none, and none is derived from the affiliation (R4, ruled 2026-10-06)
